channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 07
item.description:
28 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Train tunnel rooms are now randomised, altering tunnel layouts and navigation.
  • Animal fence placement guides now rotate correctly, making fence construction easier.
  • Holstered weapons are positioned closer to chest armor, reducing their visible silhouette when not drawn.

World & Monuments

  • Train tunnel rooms are now randomised, altering tunnel layouts and navigation.

Livestock & Animals

  • Cows now use health to reflect mood: happy cows have full health, unhappy cows lose health and can die, and eating restores health; sleeping needs are frozen.
  • Calf births no longer spawn calves behind walls, preventing them from getting stuck.
  • Sheep have been added as a new livestock animal with dedicated population assets.

Building & UI

  • Animal fence placement guides now rotate correctly, making fence construction easier.

Weapons

  • Holstered weapons are positioned closer to chest armor, reducing their visible silhouette when not drawn.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Fixed a bug that could alter MRU data during player save, preventing possible save corruption.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 06
item.description:
7 development commits

UI & Quality of Life

  • Item pickup notices now display correctly without layout glitches.

Stability

  • Players will no longer be kicked for non‑critical errors on background threads.

Items & Equipment

  • Floating bandages bug fixed – bandages now rest on the ground as intended.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Prevent unintended player rank downgrades in the editor that previously failed to kick the player, ensuring proper enforcement of permission changes.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Sep 05
item.description:
7 development commits

Animals & AI

  • Introduced a trust system for livestock: hanging around cows builds trust, allowing you to lead them, and bulls can become neutral or protective, paving the way for domestication and future bull armies.
  • Mothers now defend their calves when they are hurt, adding new defensive wildlife behavior.

Base & Structures

  • Fixed a tool cupboard replication bug that could cause the cupboard to not function correctly across the network.
